text: A boy among idols who would not bow. A son who spoke gently to a father who threatened him. A young man in the fire. A father in a dry valley. An old man laying stones for a House he would never see filled.
Every time, he was alone. And every time, Allah was enough for him.
Allah says: "There has already been for you an excellent example in Ibrahim."
And Allah left his name in our prayers. Every time we pray, we send blessings on Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim.
